24. Force Push Safety

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Force pushing can overwrite remote history. --force-with-lease checks the expected remote ref,
but coordination and care are still necessary.

# Only on an agreed personal branch:
git fetch origin
git push --force-with-lease origin feature/login
Expected: Push succeeds only if the applicable lease matches; background fetch can affect implicit leases.
Is force-with-lease risk-free? No. It checks expected refs, not whether rewriting is appropriate.
